name: quox-brain2
tagline: A second brain that feeds itself.
description: A self-feeding knowledge graph that grows on its own — sources you connect (dev sessions, notes, vaults, team conversations) are indexed automatically into ONE governed brain, and every agent can search and cite it. Not a chat log: a living, provenanced knowledge graph humans can explore and agents consume via quoxbrain_search.
shortDescription: Self-feeding second brain — agents answer from it
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Grows on its own — connect a source once, it keeps feeding itself
Agents answer from it via quoxbrain_search — no manual copy/paste into prompts
One governed, provenanced knowledge graph, not a pile of chat logs
Every source scoped (org/user/shared) and toggleable — the moat is governance
2D/3D graph explorer with facets, search, and note reader

knowledgeGraph.name: Knowledge Graph
knowledgeGraph.description: A unioned, scope-aware graph of every connected source — explore in 2D/3D, filter by scope/source/language, and read notes with backlinks/outlinks.

agentSearch.name: quoxbrain_search
agentSearch.description: Agents query the brain directly during conversations and cite what they find — no manual context-stuffing.

sourceFeed.name: Source Feed
sourceFeed.description: Connect sources (this machine's work, a folder, Obsidian, Notion, team conversations) and the brain ingests continuously without manual re-import.

changes: Initial release as the Brain2 licensed plugin (opt-in)
Packages the existing QuoxBrain engine/view behind the plugin licensing + enable gate
User-facing rebrand: QuoxBrain -> Brain2 / Brain2 (internal quoxbrain route/service unchanged)
